policy.candidate_origin: Pre-specified in Phase 13.2 from prior datasets (not selected on BDG2 validation)
policy.primary_comparison: Five-seed no-base residual CFM mixture versus frozen CatBoost
policy.seed_selection: NO seed selection based on validation or independent test; use all five seeds
policy.point_prediction: Arithmetic mean of all predictive draws per row in the original source kWh scale
policy.sampling_setting_note: Sampling/inference recipe fixed in Phase 13.2; no tuning on held-out labels
policy.interval: For each CFM, empirical 5th and 95th percentiles of pooled 5-seed draws; calibrate nonnegative additive CQR score on CAL sites only
policy.deterministic_baseline_interval: Train-fixed point prediction +/- split-conformal absolute-residual radius calibrated on CAL sites only
policy.conformal_quantile: ceil((N+1)*0.90) order statistic; separate calibration sites from fit, validation, test
policy.conformal_caveat: No 90% coverage guarantee under site-level distribution shift or correlated within-site observations
policy.meter_sample_policy: Use same source-timestamp-only deterministic 12 hours per calendar month from Phase 13.2
policy.site_split: Frozen Phase 13.0 site assignments; no site reallocation
policy.heldout_label_policy: CAL meter values only AFTER policy freeze and archive; INDEPENDENT TEST meter values only AFTER calibration lock and archive
policy.predefined_nonfit_validity: Drop missing, nonnumeric or negative meter readings; do not drop extreme valid test values
policy.time_task: Hourly electricity estimation using same-hour weather and metadata; not next-hour/day-ahead forecasting
policy.test_use: ONE immutable independent-site assessment; do not use test outcomes for model/hyperparameter selection
policy.grouped_inference_caveat: Independent test comprises three sites; report per-site results and avoid row-IID certainty claims

seed_policy: All five fixed seeds; pooled draws; no seed selection
units: hourly electricity energy kWh; contemporaneous weather, not future forecasting
